title: Thunderbird on Mediterranean Terrace
description: A vibrant yellow mythical bird creature with a long neck, black beak and orange eye stands on a stone terrace. Purple electrical energy arcs around its head and a glowing magical ring with symbols floats above its back.
prompt: A majestic yellow mythical bird with a long neck, large black beak and bright orange eye stands on a cobblestone terrace in a Mediterranean coastal town at sunset. Purple magical lightning crackles around its head while a large glowing purple ring with arcane symbols floats above its back. Stone buildings with flower-covered arches and balconies frame the scene, with a sailboat visible on the sea and distant mountains under a dramatic twilight sky.
